ports.name: EvidenceVerifier
ports.input: Original bytes, expected digests, schema and generator bindings
ports.output: Verified original-byte/schema/fidelity observations or explicit mismatch/unknown
ports.invariant: No boolean accepted from an untrusted caller

ports.name: OwnerDispositionVerifier
ports.input: Exact body, role assignment, scope, source cut, signed/attributed owner decision
ports.output: Verified matching disposition; owner authority and applicable cryptographic policy checked
ports.invariant: No synthetic fixture can substitute for a real decision

ports.name: WorkspaceContextResolver
ports.input: Durable workspace, optional real Project/Work, runtime/host/custody/store selection
ports.output: Verified scoped context and actual host capabilities
ports.invariant: Product-wide inspection does not invent a Project; project-only effects require one

ports.name: NativeEffectPort
ports.output: Actual committed/refused/unknown receipt bound to targets and original op
ports.invariant: Use existing governed native writer, not a second store/runtime

ports.name: CanonicalPublisher
ports.input: Reviewed immutable bundle, expected source selection, exact publication authorization, native receipt
ports.output: Observed publication receipt and selected postimage or explicit unknown/conflict

ports.name: ConsumerClosureObserver
ports.input: Exact root, all registered consumers/dependencies, event/cursor coverage and traversal limits
ports.output: Complete cut-bound manifest or explicit unresolved/truncated result
ports.invariant: Bounded traversal does not establish complete global impact

ports.name: IndependentConformanceAssessor
ports.input: Authored upstream obligations, generated output manifest and independent check evidence
ports.output: Exact output-bound per-obligation pass/fail/unknown and independence evidence
ports.invariant: Generator self-check is not independent conformance

common_contract: Every output binds actual subject bytes, source cut, operation identity and applicable store HEAD
Missing, refused, stale, truncated and unknown remain distinct
Observation DTOs are trusted-port contracts, not authentication protocols; hashes alone prove no role or decision
No fake handles, no runtime copies, no automatic grants or source-profile repins
